questions.question: The probability that a contractor will get a plumbing contract is 2/3 and the probability that he will not get an electric contract is 5/9.If the probability of getting at least one contract is 4/5,What is the probability that he will get both the contract. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• P (contractor will get a plumbing contract) =P(A)= 2/3…. (1 mark)
  • P (contractor will not get an electric contract) =5/9…. (1 mark)
  • P (contractor will get an electric contract) =P(B)=1-5/9=4/9…... (1 mark)
  • P (contractor will get at least one contract) = 𝑃(𝐴 ∪ 𝐵)= 4/5…. (1 mark)
  • 𝑃(𝐴 ∪ 𝐵) = 𝑃(𝐴) + 𝑃(𝐵) − 𝑃(𝐴 ∩ 𝐵)…… (1 mark)
  • 𝑃(𝐴 ∩ 𝐵) = 𝑃(𝐴) + 𝑃(𝐵) − 𝑃(𝐴 ∪ 𝐵) = 14/45… (1 mark)
